content:
Early autumn Amazon Prime Day deals are here, bringing a fresh wave of discounts: $50 off the new Mac Studio, up to $150 off M5 MacBook Air models. We're also still tracking a massive $500 price drop on silver and space black 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pros, clearance discounts on the Apple Watch Ultra 3, a wide range of TV deals, plus new accessory discounts from brands like Twelve South and Anker. Read on for all the details.

M5 Pro MacBook Pro now $500 off at Amazon in silver and space black

Although the latest M5 MacBook Air still has some noteworthy deals worth flagging, we wanted to highlight Amazon's massive $500 discount on this 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro — the space black and silver models are now both down to this stellar sale price.

Amazon is now offering the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM and 2TB of storage for $2,699 with free shipping.

This is the lowest price we've tracked in recent months, and both the space black and silver versions are available now — the latter is rarely discounted.

This machine normally retails for $3,199, now $500 off. As we noted before, in a sea of tech deals simply returning prices to previous MSRPs, this discount is actually $100 below the price before Apple's big price hike in late June.

Cheapest 15-inch M5 MacBook Air is $100 off, $150 off 24GB models

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB: $1,449 (originally $1,599)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB: $1,399 (originally $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB: $1,849 (originally $1,999)

Rare clearance deals hit small and medium black Apple Watch Ultra 3, with select models up to $200 off

The brand-new Apple Watch Ultra 4 is already on sale with launch-day early bird discounts across multiple configurations, but Amazon is also offering deep discounts on the previous-generation — still-excellent — Apple Watch Ultra 3 well below the Ultra 4.

The black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with the Milanese loop band remains the most popular deal — it's now nearly $200 off its $899 list price. While it's the standout of this clearance batch, more configurations joined the discount lineup this morning.

One thing to note, though: the other configurations are now priced the same as the Milanese version with the premium metal weave band above. The catch is that the nearly $200 discount is only available on the large size, while the medium and small sizes now have $100 off — and these popular medium configurations rarely see deals:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 (Alpine Loop): $699 (originally $799) | Medium
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 (Milanese Loop): $799 (originally $899) | Medium
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 (Trail Loop): $699 (originally $799) | Small

Again, the large black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with the Milanese loop is still the best value in this batch, but given how hard medium deals can be to come by, we think these options are worth highlighting.

Here are some Apple Watch Ultra 4 models carrying modest launch discounts:

Apple's brand-new 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio is now $50 off at Amazon

Alongside the return of early bird deals on the more affordable M6 Mac mini, those looking to upgrade to Apple's just-launched 2026 Mac Studio can now pick one up at an all-time low on Amazon.

Amazon is now offering the all-new M5 Max Mac Studio with 36GB of RAM and 512GB of storage for $2,449 with free shipping.

This machine normally retails for $2,499, now $50 off. While it's not a huge discount, if you want to upgrade at launch, saving $50 isn't a bad option — it's actually $1 cheaper than the preorder discount.

  • 2026 Mac Studio M5 Max 36GB/512GB: $2,450 (originally $2,499)

Amazon previously didn't officially sell the older Mac Studio, so it's hard to predict how this deal will be priced going forward. So far, its early bird discount looks similar to the new M6 Mac mini's, but Amazon tends to be aggressive with new Apple product launches, so it's hard to say whether this pro-level machine will see further discounts during Prime Day and Black Friday. A nearly $100 cut by year-end isn't out of the question, but as of now, we can't say for sure.

Either way, early adopters can save a bit; and for those who don't need the M5 Max with 36GB of RAM, early bird deals on select M6 Mac mini configurations have also returned:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB: $880 (originally $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB: $1,070 (originally $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB: $1,270 (originally $1,299)

Upgrade your TV before GTA VI launches with deals up to $1,100 off: LG, Samsung, Hisense and more

We're about 50 days out from the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI. While that controversial collector's edition hasn't been received too well, we'll have exclusive news on that front later today. In the meantime, we're continuing to track a range of noteworthy TV deals so you can upgrade your gaming setup before launch.
